Selenium stands as a robust and widely-utilized open-source framework designed for automating web applications. Web application testing on a variety of platforms and browsers is made easier by Selenium’s toolkit. A key feature of Selenium is its support for multiple programming languages, granting testers the flexibility to write scripts in their language of choice. Its versatility, coupled with an active community, positions Selenium as the preferred choice for automating repetitive testing tasks. The framework’s adaptability to varied programming languages and seamless cross-browser functionality makes it an invaluable asset for testers aiming to optimize their testing processes.
